verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships a built-in AI agent called 'Resolve' that takes a production error and autonomously produces a pull request for review, which is a genuine in-product AI delegation capability (rollbar-docs-17). However, evidence is limited to a single first-party doc page with no independent/hands-on corroboration, detail on task scope, or UI walkthrough of delegation flow. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Resolve, broader description of task types it can handle beyond PR generation, UI/workflow detail.
